text:
mike_support: Heads up — after the quant-profile calibration rollout yesterday we're getting multi-tenant latency alerts for rwi-13b-int8. p95 jumped to ~320ms (baseline ~140ms), p99 ~1.2s (baseline ~480ms). No obvious errors returned from the API, just higher tail latency.

sarah_ops: Which tenants/regions? any correlation with seq length or batch size?

mike_support: Affected tenants: acme-payments, learnlytics, and one internal staging org. Mostly us-west and eu-west. Alerts show worse for seq_len >= 512 and when concurrent QPS > 60.

chi_ml: I pulled traces from the console — main signal is large increase in KV-gather kernel time after the calibration change. See trace sample: `kernel.kv_gather: p50 1.2ms -> 3.6ms, p95 4ms -> 18ms` for int8 runtime. Also observed more frequent cache misses because the quantized weight layout changed sizes, which breaks some cache-friendly paths.

anita_re: The calibration job changed per-channel symmetric scaling to an alternative scheme (symmetric->asymmetric) to improve perplexity on some prompts. That changes quant layout and caused extra memory copies at runtime for seqs > 256.

jorge_infra: We should short-circuit: 1) pin affected tenants to the fp16 variant; 2) create an immediate fallback rule for rwi-13b-int8 to fp16; 3) rollback the calibration rollout for the canary group. I can push routing overrides.

mike_support: Repro steps I used (simple):

```
# baseline (fp16)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -d '{"model":"rwi-13b-fp16","input":"long-sequence-prompt...","max_tokens":512}'

# int8 (post-calibration)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -d '{"model":"rwi-13b-int8","input":"long-sequence-prompt...","max_tokens":512}'
```

Response times: fp16 p95 ~150ms, int8 p95 ~330ms on same infra node.

chi_ml: To toggle a per-tenant override (hotfix) you can use routing policy API:

```
POST /v1/routing/overrides
{
  "tenant_id": "acme-payments",
  "match": {"model": "rwi-13b-int8"},
  "action": {"route_to_model": "rwi-13b-fp16", "reason": "hotfix - int8 p95 regression"}
}
```
I pushed a test override for our staging tenant and p95 dropped back to ~160ms within 2 minutes.

anita_re: Longer-term: revert the asymmetric scaling from the calibration job and run a smaller canary to evaluate impact on kernel memory layout. For now, we should avoid a full rollback of quant support — we want int8 for cost. But we need to make calibration changes backward compatible (or versioned quant profiles).

jorge_infra: I've created a temporary cluster-level fallback rule for the affected model: route int8 -> fp16 for tenants with >50 QPS or seq_len > 256. Monitors are firing less now.

monitor-bot: [alert] rwi-13b-int8 p99 latency decreased from 1200ms -> 520ms after override (incident 2767890123-A).

mike_support: Thanks — did we capture a minimal repro log to use in support tickets? I need to send steps to customers.

chi_ml: Minimal repro attached below (paste of single-run timing):

```
# timing output (int8)
seq_len=512, tokens=512
step 1 token gen time: 0.85ms
kv_gather:  p50 3.6ms p95 18ms p99 45ms
attention_kernel: p50 1.1ms p95 2.8ms
overall p95: 330ms p99: 1200ms

# timing output (fp16)
seq_len=512, tokens=512
kv_gather:  p50 1.2ms p95 4ms p99 8ms
overall p95: 150ms p99: 480ms
```

mike_support: I'll send the ticket updates with the hotfix steps and link to the routing override API.

anita_re: Follow-up action items:
- rollback asymmetric calibration and re-run small calibration with compatibility flags
- add quant-profile versioning to avoid in-place incompatible rollouts
- add per-tenant canary gates for quant profile changes

jorge_infra: Ops actions (done):
- created routing override for acme-payments, learnlytics
- set emergency fallback policy cluster-wide for rwi-13b-int8 -> fp16 if p95 > 300ms
- started a canary rollback for the calibration job (group: canary-14).

mike_support: Customer comms drafts: short message + technical appendix. Will post to affected tenants in 15 min.

chi_ml: One more mitigation option to consider: enable on-the-fly quantization fallback in runtime (if mismatch of layout detected, re-serve with fp16 automatically and emit event). That reduces manual routing changes. Need product/design sign-off.

mike_support: Good idea. For now we have the hotfix and rollback in progress. Assigning to oncall: @sarah_ops to own the incident and follow-up postmortem.

sarah_ops: On it. I'll coordinate follow-up and schedule the postmortem for tomorrow. Closing incident when p99 < 600ms for 30m across affected tenants. :white_check_mark:
